description: Canonical encoding test vectors (D7, R15.10). Loaded by Node tests and by the Chromium test (T2.8). Generated by tests/canonical-reference/generate-vectors.mjs.

vectors.name: rfc8785-sample
vectors.note: Official RFC 8785 example. Contains 1e30, so it is encode-only: WEAVE refuses it as a value.

vectors.name: rfc8785-key-order
vectors.note: RFC 8785 section 3.2.3 sorting example (UTF-16 code unit order).
vectors.inputJson: {"\u20ac":"Euro Sign","\r":"Carriage Return","\ufb33":"Hebrew Letter Dalet With Dagesh","1":"One","\ud83d\ude00":"Emoji: Grinning Face","\u0080":"Control","\u00f6":"Latin Small Letter O With Diaeresis"}
vectors.canonical: {"\r":"Carriage Return","1":"One","":"Control","ö":"Latin Small Letter O With Diaeresis","€":"Euro Sign","😀":"Emoji: Grinning Face","דּ":"Hebrew Letter Dalet With Dagesh"}

vectors.name: utf16-vs-utf8-property-order
vectors.note: U+10000 sorts BEFORE U+E000 in UTF-16 (D800 < E000) but AFTER it in UTF-8 (F0 > EE). Canonical JSON uses UTF-16.

vectors.name: big-number-forms
vectors.note: Valid RFC 8785 output, but integers beyond the safe range are refused as values (D7).

vectors.name: non-ascii-strings-not-normalized
vectors.note: Strings are not Unicode-normalized: precomposed and decomposed forms stay different.

vectors.name: op-payload
vectors.note: A complete D2 payload. The op hash is the sha256 of this canonical text (no hash, no wallTime).

setUnion.name: strings-utf8-order
setUnion.note: Set-union output is sorted by the UTF-8 bytes of each element canonical encoding: U+E000 (EE 80 80) before U+10000 (F0 90 80 80).

setUnion.name: mixed-types
setUnion.note: Equality is by canonical encoding, so 3 and "3" are different; order is by encoding bytes.
